title: Back from the Spiritual Road
summary: Mu Chen is back at the Northern Spiritual Academy, at the initial phase of Spiritual Movement. The trial he was thrown out of is the Spiritual Road (the donghua calls it the Spiritual Land): no spiritual energy works there, and the Five Great Academies use it to temper the best youths in the Great Thousand World. He was the only one chosen from the Northern Spiritual Realm, lasted a year, and came home with the name Blood Calamity.

title: Academy competition
summary: Students fight for rank. Mu Chen meets Liu Yang in the ring and breaks through to the middle phase of Spiritual Movement during the match. The art he cultivates is the Great Pagoda Art, which this donghua calls the Great Buddha Art, left by his mother.

title: Northern Spiritual Field
summary: Heaven Class students train in the Northern Spiritual Field, still inside the small Northern Spiritual Realm. Rival students and spiritual beasts.

title: Black Eerie Swamp
summary: The donghua calls this swamp the Dark Abyss. Mu Territory and Liu Territory go in after the Nine Netherbird (Jiuyou Bird). Mu Chen reaches the late phase of Spiritual Movement, then the initial phase of Spiritual Rotation, and the bird is bound to him.
events: The bird debuts in episode 13.
She is still a Spiritual Beast. The donghua shows a human face earlier than the novel does.

title: Seats for the Five Great Academies
summary: The five academies offer a few places. For anyone raised in the Northern Spiritual Realm, this is the way out. The five are Northern Heavens, Myriad Phoenix, Saint, Martial and Azure Heavens. Each dean is a Sovereign, and each academy is guarded by an ancient divine beast.

title: After the seats are decided
summary: The fan wiki does not name a separate quest for these episodes. The next one it records is the entrance exam, which starts at episode 25. By episode 21 Mu Chen is at the late phase of Spiritual Rotation.

title: Entrance exam
summary: Northern Heavens Continent comes into view, and with it the Northern Heavens Spiritual Academy. Mu Chen enters the Spirit Stage during the exam.
cultivation: Spirit Stage: initial at episode 28, middle at episode 31.

title: Freshman year
summary: The first stretch inside the academy, including the freshman competition. The season page does not tabulate these episodes one by one, so the beats inside the block are less certain than the realm marks. He finishes the Spirit Stage and steps into Heavenly Fusion.
events: Bing Qing of the Ice Spirit Clan appears at episode 33.
cultivation: Spirit, late phase (episode 34). Heavenly Fusion, initial phase (episode 40).

title: White Dragon Sovereign's treasury
summary: A Heaven-rank mission in White Dragon City, and the end of season 1. The novel chapters adapted across the whole season are 1 through 264. His Heavenly Fusion Stage moves to the middle phase along the way.
